featured.kicker: Shipped product · web + iOS App Store
featured.title: Shayaak — Wellness App, Live on the Web and the App Store
featured.description: A full-stack wellness app (journal, tasks, goals, time and weight tracking) with Saya, an AI companion that calls 16 tools through a provider-neutral layer: the model decides, deterministic server code executes, and destructive actions can only be proposed. React (Vite) shipped natively to iOS via Capacitor with a hand-written Swift StoreKit 2 plugin; Node/Express + SQLite backend with 250+ automated tests; dual-rail billing (Stripe on web, Apple In-App Purchase on iOS with server-side receipt verification). Designed, built, released through App Store review and operated solo on my own Linux VPS.
featured.note: Private repo (commercial product): architecture walkthrough on request.

featured.title: Keeps Running — Multi-Agent Front Desk for Small Offices
featured.description: One engine running four AI agents for a small office: answer and book new inquiries, chase paperwork, read documents, keep clients updated. The model decides and code gates every action: every outbound message is held for the owner's approval, with SSN/card masking and per-person send caps. Hybrid document pipeline (on-server RapidOCR first, vision LLM only for low-confidence pages), AWS SES/S3/SNS inbound mail with verified signatures, Stripe billing, a 45-case LLM eval suite and 149 offline tests.
featured.note: Private repo: live test instance, walkthrough on request.

featured.title: Sandbox City — Crash-Test Lab for AI Shopping Agents
featured.description: Gives an AI agent a PayPal key and finds out what a malicious store page can make it do. In testing, a real model was talked into a $1,620 order shipped to an attacker's PO box on the PayPal sandbox. Sandbox City tests your own agent against 16 cases, prices each payment defense over 30 simulated days with 95% intervals, then enforces the winning rulebook at a real PayPal checkout (Orders v2, Agent Toolkit). It uses a crash-safe payment journal: a test kills the process mid-capture, and the customer is still charged exactly once.

featured.title: WoundTrace — Agentic Computer Vision on AWS
featured.description: Measure a wound from one phone photo: an Amazon Bedrock agent (Converse API, 9 tools) checks the photo, rejects tilted or blurred shots with a specific retake instruction, measures area in cm² with its uncertainty, and drafts a nurse note when healing stalls; a human approves every alert. The OpenCV segmentation model, trained in PyTorch, scores Dice 0.82 on 200 expert-annotated clinical photos, with zero false outlines on 1,378 healthy-foot photos. Deployed serverless on AWS Lambda.

portfolio.title: Market Terminal — Quant Research Platform
portfolio.description: A Bloomberg-style web terminal (live quotes, 500-stock scanner, options analytics, macro screens, paper-trading ticket) on FastAPI + WebSockets, over a 10-year bar warehouse with a no-look-ahead backtest engine. The engine uses a survivorship-bias-free universe and a deflated Sharpe ratio. 135 pytest tests in GitHub Actions. Private repo.

portfolio.title: Multi-Channel YouTube Content Agent
portfolio.description: A 7-stage pipeline that has run unattended on cloud Linux since May 2026 across 4 channels: trend discovery, research, scriptwriting, neural TTS, video assembly and scheduled uploads. It published 147 of 152 attempts (~97%) at the August audit, with per-channel failure isolation and multi-fallback alerts. Private repo.

portfolio.title: Autonomous Job Application Agent
portfolio.description: Scrapes 6 job-board APIs, LLM-scores relevance against a typed profile with hard-rejection guardrails, and renders ATS-tailored resume and cover letter PDFs deterministically, so the model cannot invent experience. Cron-driven on cloud Linux. Private repo.

portfolio.title: Grounded AI Apps — Onsite · Keyed · Runsheet · Shortlist
portfolio.description: Four small AI products, each built around one rule that stops the model from making things up. They include a site assistant that declines rather than cites a source it never retrieved, and document-to-table extraction with per-field confidence and human review. 660+ tests across the four. Private repos.

portfolio.title: Lumen — Automated Data-Analysis Dashboard
portfolio.description: Upload any dataset and get KPIs, plain-English insights, charts and Isolation Forest anomaly screening. It has a SQL sandbox and a leak-free cross-validated AutoML pipeline, and the pure-function engine is fully covered by pytest. Private repo.

portfolio.title: Supply Chain Analytics Platform
portfolio.description: Real-time ETL processing 5,000+ transactions with Pydantic validation and retry logic. Ensemble anomaly detection (Z-score, IQR, Isolation Forest, Elliptic Envelope) with severity-routed Slack/Email alerting, Holt-Winters/ARIMA forecasting validated against holdouts, and a 6-page Plotly Dash dashboard.

portfolio.title: TaskForge — Distributed Task Orchestration
portfolio.description: Cloud-native task orchestration platform: gRPC microservices, Kafka event streaming, event sourcing with CQRS and saga patterns, Kubernetes deployment with HPA autoscaling, and OpenTelemetry + Prometheus observability.

portfolio.title: Resume Tailor
portfolio.description: Local-first resume and cover letter generator: paste a job description and a locally hosted LLM (Ollama) tailors ATS-friendly PDFs. No cloud APIs — everything runs on my own machine.

portfolio.title: Mars Rover — University Rover Challenge (CS Team Lead)
portfolio.description: Led the CS team through the full lifecycle. In ROS2 on a Raspberry Pi I built global path planning with Hybrid A*, trajectory tracking with Pure Pursuit and MPC, and PID control loops. Also wrote embedded C++ for sensor subsystems over UART/SPI/I2C and built Gazebo/URDF and MATLAB/Simulink models to validate the hardware.

portfolio.title: Smart Home Network
portfolio.description: ESP32 smart-home network: sensor, LCD and control firmware in C++, with full design docs.

portfolio.title: Battleship (C++)
portfolio.description: Classic Battleship built in modern C++ with an object-oriented design and CSV-based game persistence.

portfolio.title: Web Page Rank
portfolio.description: PageRank implemented and optimized over the Stanford web graph (~280K nodes) using NetworkX and sparse matrix operations, with visualizations of community structure and node importance.

openSource.title: Record tool definitions passed as Mistral SDK models in mlflow.mistral.autolog() traces
openSource.description: Found that MLflow's Mistral autolog silently dropped tool definitions passed as SDK model objects (issue #26954), wrote the fix with a regression test verified against mistralai 1.10.0 and 2.10.1, and saw it through review into master (Nov 2026).

openSource.title: Record streaming chat completions in mlflow.groq.autolog() traces
openSource.description: Reported that Groq autolog recorded a raw <groq.Stream object> as the span output for streaming completions (#27075), filed the feature request (#27233), and opened the PR that adds streaming trace support.

openSource.title: bee-cli-python — Python client for the Bee wearable
openSource.description: A dependency-free Python client covering more of the Bee CLI than the official Node library: typed live events, reconnects with backoff, and a FakeBee for testing without a device.
